courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的隧道與地下設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。

related.title: 地下岩洞穹頂支護
related.transfer: 可遷移「相變熱量的機理與驗證」與「凍脹差異的機理與驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；地下岩洞穹頂支護的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Latent heat mechanism and verification" and "Differential frost heave mechanism and verification" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Underground cavern crown support must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦凍結壁閉合、地下水熱輸送與融沉控制；地下岩洞穹頂支護則以岩洞穹頂的節理楔塊、岩拱與複合支護為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on frozen-wall closure, groundwater heat transport and thaw settlement; Underground cavern crown support centres on cavern-crown joint wedges, rock arching and composite support, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「相變熱量」與「節理楔塊」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到地下岩洞穹頂支護，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「交叉口開口率的機理與驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Latent heat” and “Joint wedge”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Underground cavern crown support, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Intersection opening ratio mechanism and verification", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 交叉隧道人工地盤凍結
history.text: 人工地盤凍結透過冷卻與相變暫時增加地層強度並減少滲流，卻同時引入熱量、凍脹及解凍變形問題。本課將凍結管幾何、對流熱輸送、長期潛變與備援冷量分開檢查，再建立從臨時凍土支護轉交永久襯砌的證據與停留點。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。2016年：Crossrail發布聯絡通道工法與地質資料，明確說明所列通道未採凍結；2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景；2017年：美國聯邦公路管理局地盤改良頁列入兩冊地盤改良參考手冊。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。
history.textEn: Artificial ground freezing temporarily strengthens ground and restricts seepage through cooling and phase change, while introducing thermal, heave and thaw-deformation concerns. The course separately examines pipe geometry, advective heat, creep and cooling reserves, then builds evidence and hold points for transferring support from frozen soil to the permanent lining. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 2016: Crossrail publishes its passage-method dataset, explicitly identifying nonuse of freezing in the listed passages; 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference; 2017: FHWA lists the two-volume ground-modification reference manual in its improvement guidance. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.
